3099-4762-7704-8320.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting three +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Yoshimaru and Doc Samson.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

4094-7282-8160.easyPrerequisites:
At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
Kwia's ability hasn't triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
4094-7282-8160.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Gain life.
Kwia triggers, creating two Lotus tokens due to Kaya, Geist Hunter.
Activate a Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating two token copies of the Lotus token.
Activate two Loti by tapping and sacrificing them, adding six mana of any color.
Repeat from step 5.
4094-7282-8160.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Chrome Dome can target other artifacts as desired.

1479-2841-4288-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-4288-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Sarinth Greatwurm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1170-4985-5131-6495--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4985-5131-6495--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-4985-5131-6495--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

654-2557-3129-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

225-3129-4365-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3836-4067-5078-7914.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Iron Lad.
Activate Iron Lad by tapping it, revealing Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library and then drawing it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Urza.
Repeat

4908-5078-6089.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

670-1619-3991-6142.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3991-6142.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Eccentric Apprentice.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, it triggers, returning Eccentric Apprentice from exile to the battlefield.
When Eccentric Apprentice enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Eccentric Apprentice trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Eccentric Apprentice.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7229.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ambitious Dragonborn.
When Ambitious Dragonborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

49-2034-2452-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1563-2457-2557-6968.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

4067-5116-6281-6927.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Damage Control Crew.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Damage Control Crew that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Damage Control Crew from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

4050-4215-6730.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, moving any counters from it onto another creature you control, and then shuffling Sin into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Sin and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
4050-4215-6730.notes: In order to get infinite +1/+1 counters, remove as many counters as possible when Sin enters, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin as it enters. Those counters can then be moved to another creature when Sin dies.

3358-3499-4881.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

2577-5670-6578.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-6578.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2577-5670-6578.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

880-3534-4826.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control at least one additional creature.
880-3534-4826.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the land enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1525-2031-2406-2660-5400.notablePrerequisites:
Synth Infiltrator is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-5400.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-5400.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

526-2232-5231-5415.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nonartifact creature token.
526-2232-5231-5415.description:
Cast Vexing Devil by paying {R}.
When Vexing Devil enters the battlefield, it, Cloudstone Curio and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Life Finds a Way trigger, creating a copy of any nonartifact creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Vexing Devil to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Vexing Devil trigger from sttep 2, doing nothing.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat.

38-1288-3359-3705.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Hofri triggers, exiling Squee from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing the Squee token, adding {R}.
When the Squee token dies, it triggers, returning Squee from exile to your graveyard.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1309-2564-3603-4231.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it and Lonis trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2660-4872-4899.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer by exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat step 1 until you have an empty library.
Resolve the first Phyrexian Devourer ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it.
If Phyrexian Devourer's power is at least seven, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one, and put Time Warp on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp from your library.
Repeat from step 6.

1346-1810-2743.description:
Cast Repeated Reverberation by paying {2}{R}{R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {1}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Repeated Reverberation triggers, copying Cackling Counterpart twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Cackling Counterparts, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1580-2060-3602-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and goading it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1628-3197-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Herd Baloth.
You control another creature to sacrifice.
1628-3197-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Beast token, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

2349-2724-3217.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Mistmeadow Witch. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1335-2265-2744-5296.notablePrerequisites:
Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
Workhorse has at least one +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2265-2744-5296.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Elemental token.
Cathars' Crusade triggers putting two +1/+1 counter to all creatures you control.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1544-4017-4968.notablePrerequisites:
Vampiric Link and Sunbond attached to Deathbringer Thoctar.
Deathbringer Thoctar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1544-4017-4968.description:
Remove a +1+1 counter from Deathbringer Thoctar to have it deal 1 damage to an opponent.
Vampiric Link triggers, gaining you 1 life.
Deathbringer Thoctar gets a +1+1 counter from Sunbond.
Repeat until opponent are dead.

1964-1987-2427-4125.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

411-913-3168-4893.description:
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {R}.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {1}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
